test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A person starts to walk from a ground in the west direction to reach his home. After 13km he reaches at point Y. From point Y, he takes a right turn, walks 7 km and reaches point C. From point C, he takes a left turn, walks 9km and reaches point T. From point T, he takes a left turn and walks 4km and reaches his home.

What is the shortest distance between his home and point Y?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Trace the path and find the straight-line distance using the Pythagoras theorem.

Given:

From Y → 7 km (south), then 9 km (east), then 4 km (north).

Net movement from Y:

Vertical = 7 − 4 = 3 km (south)

Horizontal = 9 km (east)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3edee79b0ee7f76c2eadc4a1eae186303c846257cc306467ed06da203053b8a1.png] 

Distance = √(9² + 3²) = √(81 + 9) = √90 = 3√10

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
